_comment: Capsule toy series (issue #139 phase 1): the prizes in one capsule SKU. One turn in rare_one_in is the rare prize, the rest one of the variants; the prize follows from the sale id (no random draw). Fictional mascots and goods only; no real brand, character or toy line.
_comment_phase2: Phase 2: a series with `limited` is sold in turns — it can be ordered only on days where (day % every_days) < for_days, and in those days customers want it more (pull); stock already in a machine still sells afterwards. A machine slot that turns empty is announced so it can be refilled.
